news.title: mimalloc: A new, high-performance, scalable memory allocator for the modern era
news.summary_raw:
mimalloc is an open-source, modern, scalable memory allocator that is a drop-in replacement for malloc and free. It is relatively small (~12K lines), with clear internal data structures, and is easy to build and integrate into other projects. It provides bounded worst-case allocation times (up to OS primitives), bounded space overhead, low internal fragmentation, and minimal contention by relying almost exclusively on atomic operations.
The post mimalloc: A new, high-performance, scalable memory
news.summary: Microsoft Research has released mimalloc, an open-source memory allocator, which is a high-performance and scalable drop-in replacement for malloc and free. This memory allocator provides bounded worst-case allocation times, minimal space overhead, and low internal fragmentation, making it suitable for modern systems.
news.enterprise_use: Check if your system uses the standard system allocator and if replacing it with mimalloc could improve performance and reduce contention, most notably in systems using CrowdStrike to monitor memory-intensive processes. Missing this opportunity means relying on suboptimal memory management. Note this in your next 90-day review for potential implementation.
